title: EdgeRIC real-time scheduling
description: dashboard-realtime-scheduling xApp (jrtc-apps/jrtc_apps/dashboard_realtime_scheduling) and tcp_probe on the UPF.

list.name: smooth
list.label: Average over
list.description: Trailing moving average for the per-UE panels. 134 ms shows each bucket (TCP then shows ACK bursts); 1 s matches iperf's per-second reports. The CQI walks wander for seconds, so the throughput only settles over 10-30 s, at the cost of reacting that much later to a switch.

panels.title: UE identity: core (IMSI, IP, NGAP) to gNB (DU UE index, C-RNTI)
panels.description: One row per UE in the cell. DU UE index and C-RNTI come with every gNB slot report; ue_map.txt (scripts/ue_rnti_map.sh, the names the EdgeRIC muApps use) names each C-RNTI ue<n>, and UE n has IMSI ...n on this testbed. IMSI, IP and the NGAP UE IDs are the core's view (scripts/core_ue_info.sh). Published as rts_ue_ids by the dashboard-realtime-scheduling xApp. A UE without a name in ue_map.txt shows as du<index>.

targets.expr: max by (n, imsi, ip, amf_ue_ngap_id, ran_ue_ngap_id, du, rnti) (last_over_time(rts_ue_ids[10s]))

panels.title: Scheduler
panels.description: The muApp's scheduler, from its own edgeric_rt metrics (scripts/edgeric_muapp.sh start sched ...). Without a muApp the gNB runs its own scheduler.

targets.expr: (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="maxweight"}[1s])) * 0 + 1) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="maxcqi"}[1s])) * 0 + 2) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="bestcqi"}[1s])) * 0 + 3) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="pf"}[1s])) * 0 + 4) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="rr"}[1s])) * 0 + 5) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="fixed"}[1s])) * 0 + 6) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="rl"}[1s])) * 0 + 7) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="stock"}[1s])) * 0 + 8) or vector(0)

panels.title: TTIs run by the muApp
panels.description: Share of DL slots that applied a muApp action meant for exactly that TTI (RT-E2 HIT). The rest ran the gNB's own scheduler. From the rts_stats codelet.

targets.expr: avg_over_time(rts_cell_hit_pct[5s])

panels.title: Cell DL, gNB (5 s)
panels.description: DRB bytes the gNB scheduled, all UEs, averaged over 5 s.

targets.expr: sum(avg_over_time(rts_cell_dl_mbps[5s]))

panels.title: Cell DL received (5 s)
panels.description: What the UEs received, all UEs, averaged over 5 s: TCP bytes they ACKed (tcpdump on the UPF) plus UDP their receivers logged.

targets.expr: (sum(avg_over_time(tcp_throughput_mbps[5s])) + sum(avg_over_time(ue_rx_mbps[5s]))) or sum(avg_over_time(tcp_throughput_mbps[5s])) or sum(avg_over_time(ue_rx_mbps[5s]))

panels.title: Per UE, averaged over $smooth (134 ms buckets of the gNB slot reports and of tcpdump on the UPF, on the same grid)
Scheduler
panels.description: Which scheduler ran when: the muApp's (edgeric_rt metrics), else the gNB's own.

targets.expr: (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="maxweight"}[1s])) * 0 + 1) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="maxcqi"}[1s])) * 0 + 2) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="bestcqi"}[1s])) * 0 + 3) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="pf"}[1s])) * 0 + 4) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="rr"}[1s])) * 0 + 5) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="fixed"}[1s])) * 0 + 6) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="rl"}[1s])) * 0 + 7) or (max(last_over_time(edgeric_rt_dl_hit_pct{scheduler="stock"}[1s])) * 0 + 8) or vector(0)

panels.title: DL CQI
panels.description: Wideband CQI the UE reported, averaged over the bucket's slots (the channel the scheduler sees).

targets.expr: (avg_over_time(rts_ue_cqi[$smooth]) * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(rts_ue_ids[10s]))) or on(du) label_replace(avg_over_time(rts_ue_cqi[$smooth]), "n", "du$1", "du", "(.*)")

panels.title: DL backlog
panels.description: Bytes waiting for the UE in the gNB (RLC queues, all logical channels), averaged over the bucket's slots.

targets.expr: (avg_over_time(rts_ue_backlog_bytes[$smooth]) * on(du) group_left(n) max by (du, n) (last_over_time(rts_ue_ids[10s]))) or on(du) label_replace(avg_over_time(rts_ue_backlog_bytes[$smooth]), "n", "du$1", "du", "(.*)")

panels.title: DL throughput received: TCP (tcpdump on the UPF), UDP (UE receivers)
panels.description: What each UE received. TCP: bytes newly ACKed on the server-to-UE flows, from tcpdump in the UPF's tcpdumper container (telemetry/tcp_probe.py), per 134 ms bucket. UDP: the bytes each UE's receiver (udp_sink.pl or iperf3 -s, scripts/traffic_nue.sh) logs every second (telemetry/ue_rx_probe.py); the UPF cannot see UDP delivery, as UDP has no ACKs. Thick lines: the mean of the total under the scheduler that runs, since it started (within the time range), in the scheduler's color.

targets.expr: (avg_over_time(tcp_throughput_mbps[$smooth]) * on(ip) group_left(n) max by (ip, n) (last_over_time(rts_ue_ids[10s]))) or on(ip) label_replace(avg_over_time(tcp_throughput_mbps[$smooth]), "n", "$1", "ue", "(.*)")
(avg_over_time(ue_rx_mbps[$smooth]) or last_over_time(ue_rx_mbps[1500ms]))
